communities.computed_on: one-mode projection (obligation-obligation via shared instrument); not the multimodal network itself, see provenance_note

provenance_note: All figures computed from S3a_provision_linked_records_78.csv (v0.2 data package). This is a two-mode (instrument x obligation) network; the actor layer (actor x instrument reach, used by the webapp's Political Brain / Actors Explorer) is a separate, webapp-only presentation layer and is not part of this supplementary table. The SPAR-comparison bridge is likewise not derived here (see package README). Community/modularity figures are computed on a one-mode projection and should not be read as a validated structural-hole or clustering statistic on the multimodal network (Knoke, Diani, Hollway & Christopoulos, Multimodal Political Networks, Cambridge University Press, 2021, doi:10.1017/9781108985000).
